title: Promoting the growth of rice and reducing the accumulation of Cd in rice by pig bedding derived carbon dots (PBCDs) under Cd stress
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00682H, Paper
Tianlian He, Xingyu Hao, Ying Chen, Zhenguo Li, Xinyu Zheng, Mingwei Yang, YuLin Wang, Chengzhen Gu, Jianghua Ye, Haibin Wang
PBCDs enhance antioxidant enzyme activities in rice, mitigating the impact of Cd on photosynthesis, reducing MDA levels. Resulting in lower Cd levels in leaves and stems and alleviating growth inhibition.
